voices.note: the mishnah cited at 26a.2 (Berakhot 3:5, 22b): כמה ירחיק מהן ומן הצואה -- ארבע אמות
reporter of the Rav Huna chain (26a.2) and author of the Persian-privies ruling (26a.6)

props.gloss_en: how far must one distance himself from them and from feces? four cubits
they taught four cubits only when it is behind him; before him he distances as far as his eyes can see
feces before him: he distances to the limit of his sight
and the same rule (full-sight distancing before him) holds for prayer
one may stand facing a privy and pray
the permission speaks of a privy that has no feces in it
the privy the Sages spoke of -- even with no feces in it; and the bathhouse they spoke of -- even with no person in it
rather, the permission speaks of a new privy, never yet used
he designated a structure as a privy: does designation take effect (to forbid) or not?
Ravina's dilemma was about standing INSIDE it to pray; about facing it he had no dilemma -- facing a designated, unused privy is permitted
Persian privies, though they hold feces, are considered as sealed (built on an incline; the feces rolls away underground)

questions.gloss_en: designating a structure as a privy: does the designation itself forbid (prayer inside it), or not? Raised by Ravina, narrowed to the inside case, never resolved here

objections.gloss_en: איני?! והא אמר רפרם בר פפא אמר רב חסדא: עומד אדם כנגד בית הכסא ומתפלל -- if before-him needs full-sight distance for prayer, how may one pray facing a privy?

answered_by.gloss_en: הכא במאי עסקינן -- בבית הכסא שאין בו צואה (= p_okimta_ein_bo_tzoah). Itself attacked and displaced at 26a.4; the surviving harmonization is the chain through p_okimta_chadtei

objections.gloss_en: איני?! והאמר רב יוסף בר חנינא: בית הכסא שאמרו אף על פי שאין בו צואה -- an empty privy is still a privy, so the empty-privy harmonization fails; conceded (אלא) and replaced by the new-privy okimta

והא מיבעי ליה לרבינא: הזמינו לבית הכסא מהו, יש זימון או אין זימון -- the new-privy okimta seems to settle what Ravina left open (source is the QUESTION q_hazmana, not a prop -- an objection sourced from a dilemma has no source slot)

answered_by.gloss_en: כי קא מיבעי ליה לרבינא למיקם עליה לצלויי בגויה, אבל כנגדו לא -- the dilemma concerned praying INSIDE it; facing it is permitted either way (= p_ravina_scope)
